title: React + TypeScript Architecture: Components, State & Server Data
concept: Build React screens that stay correct as they grow: feature boundaries, typed props and UI state, reducers as the single source of truth, effects that do not loop or go stale, a typed API layer, server state with query keys and invalidation, debounced search, controlled forms, rendering cost and tests for the logic behind the UI.
description: An intermediate course for developers who can write React components and now need them to survive a growing codebase. Every lesson starts from an incident on the CodeDev course catalog - a filter that forgets the page number, a screen that fetches in an endless loop, a search box that shows results for what you typed three keystrokes ago, an AI patch that silences the exhaustive-deps rule and freezes the filter, a list that still shows a course you just left - and fixes it by moving the logic into pure, typed functions you can test: catalog filters and pagination, UI state unions, reducers, effect dependencies and stale closures, a typed API client, query keys and invalidation, debounce with cancellation, forms, memoization and testing. 11 lessons with quizzes on real code and evidence, and hands-on JavaScript and TypeScript challenges.
